# Popup

Header: `winui/ui/dialogs/Popup.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/dialogs/Popup.hpp`.

Floats one child above the tree, at an offset from where the [Popup](#uipopup) sits.

The [Popup](#uipopup) itself takes no space in layout and draws no background, border or shadow. While it is open, the window measures the child at its natural size and places its top-left corner at the [Popup](#uipopup)'s position plus the offsets. A child running past the window edge is clipped and stays where it is. Light dismiss is off by default, so the popup stays open until `set_open(false)` and clicks outside reach the page. With light dismiss on, a click outside or Escape closes it, and it holds keyboard focus while open and gives it back on close. In a spec tree it is built by [`ui::Popup`](#uipopup), usually with [`is_open`](#is_open) bound to a [Property](../core/property.md).

Example: 
```cpp
auto stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
ui::ButtonControl* show  = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Show popup"));
ui::PopupControl*  popup = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::PopupControl>());
ui::ButtonControl* close = popup->set_child(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Close"));
popup->set_horizontal_offset(200.0f);
popup->set_light_dismiss(true);
popup->set_child_transitions({ui::PopupTransition{}});
show->on_click([popup] { popup->set_open(true); });
close->on_click([popup] { popup->set_open(false); });
popup->on_closed([] { /* closed by the button, a click outside or Escape */ });
window.set_content(std::move(stack));

// Declaratively, with the open state in a Property:
ui::Property<bool> open{false};
std::unique_ptr<ui::Element> node = ui::build(ui::Popup{
    .is_open       = open, // two-way: a light dismiss writes false into `open`
    .light_dismiss = true,
    .content       = ui::Text{.text = "Simple Popup"},
}); // add `node` to any panel
```

## `ui::Popup`

One child floated above the tree at an offset from where the popup sits, with no chrome of its own. Builds a [ui::PopupControl](#uipopupcontrol), which takes no room in layout.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<bool> open{false};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{ .content = {
    ui::Button{ .text = "Show Popup", .on_click = [&] { open = true; } },
    ui::Popup{ .is_open           = open,
               .horizontal_offset = 200,
               .light_dismiss     = true,
               .content           = ui::Text{ .text = "Simple Popup" } },
}});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::Popup{
    .is_open, .horizontal_offset, .vertical_offset, .light_dismiss, .child_transitions, .style,
    .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height,
    .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .accessibility,
    .on_opened, .on_closed, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus,
    .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uipopup-is_open"></span>`is_open` | `ui::TwoWayField<bool>` | `{false}` | Whether the child is showing. |
| <span id="uipopup-horizontal_offset"></span>`horizontal_offset` | `ui::Binding<float>` | `{0.0f}` | The child's horizontal offset from the popup's own position, in DIPs. |
| <span id="uipopup-vertical_offset"></span>`vertical_offset` | `ui::Binding<float>` | `{0.0f}` | The child's vertical offset from the popup's own position, in DIPs. |
| <span id="uipopup-light_dismiss"></span>`light_dismiss` | `ui::Binding<bool>` | `{false}` | Whether an outside click or Escape closes it. |
| <span id="uipopup-child_transitions"></span>`child_transitions` | `ui::Binding<ui::TransitionList>` |  | The transitions the child plays ([ui::PopupControl::set_child_transitions()](#set_child_transitions)). A [PopupTransition](../tree/element-transitions.md#struct-popuptransition) animates the child opening and closing. |
| <span id="uipopup-on_opened"></span>`on_opened` | `ui::Action` |  | Raised once the child is showing. |
| <span id="uipopup-on_closed"></span>`on_closed` | `ui::Action` |  | Raised however it closed, including a click outside or Escape. A two-way bound [`is_open`](#uipopup-is_open) has been written by then. |
| <span id="uipopup-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uipopup-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uipopup-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uipopup-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uipopup-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uipopup-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uipopup-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::Popup>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uipopup-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | The floated content; it draws its own background, if any. |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

### build

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<Element> build()&&
```

Consumes the spec and returns the built [ui::PopupControl](#uipopupcontrol); the caller owns it.

## `ui::PopupControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`.

Floats one child above the tree, at an offset from where the [Popup](#uipopup) sits.

The [Popup](#uipopup) itself takes no space in layout and draws no background, border or shadow. While it is open, the window measures the child at its natural size and places its top-left corner at the [Popup](#uipopup)'s position plus the offsets. A child running past the window edge is clipped and stays where it is. Light dismiss is off by default, so the popup stays open until `set_open(false)` and clicks outside reach the page. With light dismiss on, a click outside or Escape closes it, and it holds keyboard focus while open and gives it back on close. In a spec tree it is built by [`ui::Popup`](#uipopup), usually with [`is_open`](#is_open) bound to a [Property](../core/property.md).

Example: 
```cpp
auto stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
ui::ButtonControl* show  = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Show popup"));
ui::PopupControl*  popup = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::PopupControl>());
ui::ButtonControl* close = popup->set_child(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Close"));
popup->set_horizontal_offset(200.0f);
popup->set_light_dismiss(true);
popup->set_child_transitions({ui::PopupTransition{}});
show->on_click([popup] { popup->set_open(true); });
close->on_click([popup] { popup->set_open(false); });
popup->on_closed([] { /* closed by the button, a click outside or Escape */ });
window.set_content(std::move(stack));

// Declaratively, with the open state in a Property:
ui::Property<bool> open{false};
std::unique_ptr<ui::Element> node = ui::build(ui::Popup{
    .is_open       = open, // two-way: a light dismiss writes false into `open`
    .light_dismiss = true,

```

### PopupControl

```cpp
PopupControl()
```

A closed popup with no child, zero offsets and light dismiss off. Not hit-test visible: it draws nothing where it sits, so a press there goes to what is under it.

### set_child

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* set_child(std::unique_ptr<T> child)
```

Takes ownership of the floated child and returns a non-owning observer to it. The child is not part of the main tree. The window lays it out and draws it while the popup is open.

### child

```cpp
Element* child() const
```

The floated child (non-owning), or nullptr.

### is_open

```cpp
bool is_open() const
```

Whether the popup is open. Opening raises on_opened. Closing raises on_closed, whether by [set_open()](#set_open), a click outside or Escape. Setting the value it already has raises nothing.

### set_open

```cpp
void set_open(bool open)
```

Opens or closes the popup. With child transitions, the child stays on screen after closing until its close transition has played (see [`closing()`](#closing)).

### horizontal_offset

```cpp
float horizontal_offset() const
```

The child's offset from the [Popup](#uipopup)'s own position, in DIPs. 0 by default.

### set_horizontal_offset

```cpp
void set_horizontal_offset(float offset)
```

Sets the horizontal offset. The child moves on the next layout.

### vertical_offset

```cpp
float vertical_offset() const
```

The child's vertical offset from the [Popup](#uipopup)'s position, in DIPs; 0 by default.

### set_vertical_offset

```cpp
void set_vertical_offset(float offset)
```

Sets the vertical offset. The child moves on the next layout.

### light_dismiss

```cpp
bool light_dismiss() const
```

Whether light dismiss is on; false by default. On, a click outside the child or Escape closes the popup, and it holds keyboard focus while open.

### set_light_dismiss

```cpp
void set_light_dismiss(bool enabled)
```

Turns light dismiss on or off. Takes effect at once, on an open popup too.

### on_opened

```cpp
void on_opened(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fired after the popup opens. Replaces any previous handler.

### on_closed

```cpp
void on_closed(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fired after the popup closes, whether by `set_open(false)`, a click outside or Escape. Reset state bound to [`is_open()`](#is_open) here. Replaces any previous handler.

### child_transitions

```cpp
const TransitionList& child_transitions() const
```

The transitions the child plays; empty by default. A [PopupTransition](../tree/element-transitions.md#struct-popuptransition) slides the child in from its offset and fades it in on open, and fades it out on close. A [ContentTransition](../tree/element-transitions.md#struct-contenttransition) also plays both ways, and an [EntranceTransition](../tree/element-transitions.md#struct-entrancetransition) on open only.

### set_child_transitions

```cpp
void set_child_transitions(TransitionList transitions)
```

Sets the child's transitions. Applies from the next open or close.

### closing

```cpp
bool closing() const
```

Whether the child is still on screen after closing, playing its close transition.

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

Screen readers see the [Popup](#uipopup) as an empty group where it sits. They see the child only while the popup is open.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

Always zero: the [Popup](#uipopup) takes no space in layout.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Position children within the rect [arrange()](../tree/element.md#arrange) settled on (also in [bounds()](../tree/element.md#bounds), window DIPs). Default: nothing, for a leaf.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

What the control draws, in layout coordinates; [render()](../tree/element.md#render) has already applied the visual layer. A container draws its children through their [render()](../tree/element.md#render), never their [render_override()](#render_override).

### clear_dirty_override

```cpp
void clear_dirty_override(DirtyFlags flags) override
```

This element's own part of clear_dirty(): clear any part it owns but leaves out of [for_each_child()](../tree/element.md#for_each_child) (a parked page, a hidden button), through that part's clear_dirty(). Default: nothing.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

This element's own part of [tick()](../tree/element.md#tick): a clock of its own ([ToolTip](tool-tip.md#uitooltip)'s hover delay, an animation's phase, a caret blink). Runs after the visual layer has advanced and before the children are ticked, which [tick()](../tree/element.md#tick) does by itself. Tick only parts that [for_each_child()](../tree/element.md#for_each_child) does not list here. Default: nothing.
